candidate_2_adaptive_moment.source_geometry: For source i define d_i=sigma_i*u_i, where u_i is the unit LOS vector. A knot signature is the exact periodic TSC nearest-node tuple and ordered epsilon breakpoints in [-8,8]; sources share a bin only when this topology and all interval boundaries are identical.
candidate_2_adaptive_moment.response_definition: On each fixed signature interval r, W_{c,i}(epsilon)=sum_{k=0}^6 a_{c,i,r,k} epsilon^k exactly, and R_{c,i}=Z_T^-1*sum_r sum_{k=0}^6 a_{c,i,r,k} mu_k(r), where mu_k(r)=integral_{break_r}^{break_{r+1}} epsilon^k phi(epsilon)d epsilon and T=8.
candidate_2_adaptive_moment.retained_statistics: For signature h, population p, interval r, polynomial coefficient k=0..6 and frozen derivative direction j in {0..22}, retain C[p,h,j,r,k]=sum_{i in (p,h)} d_j m_i(theta) a_{c,i,r,k}. j=0 is value/mass; j=1..22 are the frozen likelihood JVP/VJP directions. This is a one-dimensional epsilon-moment contraction, not a multi-dimensional Taylor expansion.
candidate_2_adaptive_moment.certified_error_bound: Residual is exactly zero for a common exact knot signature because the Q1 integrand is degree six in epsilon on every fixed interval. No seventh-order derivative or cross-knot Taylor certificate is asserted; a non-signature bin is singleton/overflow and fails closed.
candidate_2_adaptive_moment.heldout_rule: Exact signature topology, singleton policy, coefficient basis, T=8 normalization and tolerances are frozen before any one-shot held-out evaluation; no held-out split or retuning is allowed.
candidate_2_adaptive_moment.cold_particle_rule: Use the exact Q1 zero-scale TSC branch when sigma=0. For 0<sigma<64*eps_float64*cell_spacing, use sourcewise exact evaluation; no regularization or derivative extrapolation is permitted.

measured compression ratio or streamed resource use is not demonstrated

candidate_3_deposit_then_convolve.deposit_definition: For intermediate mesh cell m and population p, deposit D[p,m,j,alpha,r]=sum_i d_j m_i(theta) delta_x_i^alpha tensor d_i^{tensor r} for |alpha|+r<=6, where delta_x_i=x_i-x_m and d_i=sigma_i*u_unit_i. The complete six-dimensional total-degree basis has 924 components; joint LOS/sigma statistics are not reduced to six scalar mass fields.
candidate_3_deposit_then_convolve.convolution_definition: The analytic cell-integrated LOS kernel is applied to the retained joint delta_x/u moments; no single kernel is defined from mass-only fields.
candidate_3_deposit_then_convolve.noncommutation_contract: deposit(convolve(source)) and convolve(deposit(source)) are not assumed equal. Any later implementation must compare candidate output directly with the Q1 sourcewise oracle on identical source realization, topology, T=8 tail normalization and derivative directions.
falsification_conditions: joint LOS/sigma tensor statistics cannot be retained under the 64 GiB host and 16 GiB device ceilings
a certified truncation bound is unavailable
any mass-only or scalar-density substitution is attempted
candidate_3_deposit_then_convolve.promotion_rule: If any condition above occurs, candidate-3 is terminally NO-GO and cannot be rescued by tolerance relaxation or held-out retuning.

interpretation: Candidate-2's seven coefficients are per common-knot interval, not a global seven-field bound. In the exact-signature worst case G=M and K=64, the projected 3.18 TiB representation is infeasible; no compression or device feasibility claim is made.

Candidate-3's six-dimensional total-degree<=6 joint basis has 924 components: 292.36 GiB for six value fields and 6.57 TiB with 23 directions. It fails both host and device ceilings absent a separately proven sparse representation.
These are analytic projections, not allocations or timing measurements. Cold JIT and gradient launches are not authorized in Q5.
